read.thesis: Ally Q2 CY26 earnings rose on auto originations of $13.3B (up 21% YoY) and Corporate Finance ROE of 32%, but provision rose 12% YoY to $430M on asset growth and no numeric guidance was given.

triggers.label: Originations up 21% YoY to $13.3B
triggers.quote: Our scale and market position drove record application volume supporting more than $13 billion in originations, up 21% year-over-year.

triggers.label: Retail auto yield 9.09% on originations
triggers.quote: Estimated retail auto originated yield was 9.09% in the quarter with 47% of originations in our highest credit quality tier.

red_flags.label: Provision up 12% YoY on asset growth
red_flags.quote: Provision for credit losses increased $46 million year over year to $430 million, as continued improvement in credit was offset by CECL reserve build associated with asset growth during the quarter.

red_flags.label: Retail deposits down $2.6B QoQ
red_flags.quote: Retail deposits of $143.6 billion were up $408 million year over year, and down $2.6 billion quarter over quarter.
